summary: NYLA supports maintaining E-Rate as a core component of the Universal Service Fund and opposes any proposal to alter the program. The comments highlight the essential role of E-Rate in providing reliable internet access to libraries and schools, which are critical for various services and programs in the community. The NYLA emphasizes the financial support provided by E-Rate and the potential impact of its termination on libraries and schools. The library community in New York emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining library services and access to digital resources. The director of government relations and advocacy urges the FCC to maintain the program to ensure libraries can continue providing essential services.
